title: Test untested keystore error codes BAD_VERSION KDF_WEAK BAD_ITER INVALID_DER
description: wolfp11/wp11_keystore.h defines 14 WP11_KEYSTORE_ERR_* codes but only 4 are exercised by test/wp11_test_keystore.c. Four specific triggerable codes are completely untested: WP11_KEYSTORE_ERR_BAD_VERSION (returned when version byte != 0x01), WP11_KEYSTORE_ERR_KDF_WEAK (iterations < 100000), WP11_KEYSTORE_ERR_BAD_ITER (iterations > INT_MAX), WP11_KEYSTORE_ERR_INVALID_DER (bad DER in wp11_keystore_detect_key_type). Each can be triggered by crafting a specific binary input and calling wp11_keystore_load or wp11_keystore_detect_key_type. The oracle is the specific error code returned.
